_comment: Task table for residual TD3. One entry per task; each becomes a dataclass in
giovi/scripts/ensure_task_config.py. Add a task here rather than editing
Class and Hydra names are derived from the task key:
Every field except `dataset` is optional; anything omitted keeps the
ResidualTD3DexmgConfig default. `base_policy` is deliberately absent -- the
wandb_project/run_id of the BC run is written into the generated class by
the launch script, per the README.
`num_episodes` sizes the offline replay buffer (horizon * num_episodes) and caps
how many episodes are loaded, so keep it at the count the dataset actually has.
CubeToContainerG1 is set for the planned 200-episode collection; the Hub copy is
still at 97, so lower it or re-collect before a real run.

CubeToContainer.description: Single-arm Panda pick-and-place, registered by the `simple_env` package.

CubeToContainerG1.description: Bimanual Unitree G1 + Inspire hands pick-and-place, registered by the `simple_env` package.
